author: driver
content: Fixed. Copied .gdt archives to ~/.config/ghidra/ghidra_12.0.2_NIX/data/ and ran UpdateArchivePaths.java on all zen2 programs (23 total). The script uses a remove+re-resolve+re-associate cycle: for each broken FILE-type source archive (path=null), it opens the matching .gdt via FileDataTypeManager, collects linked data types, removes the broken archive reference, resolves a fresh one from the .gdt, and re-associates all types. 7 archives fixed per program with types: CcpIf(33), PspSev(80), PspSvcIf(21), TE(11), PspHw(1), ArXbShared(1), TrustedOsInterface(1). zen4/zen4_coherent had no broken refs. generic_clib(path=null) left as-is (Ghidra built-in). PROJECT-type archives (VMSA, SecOS) were already fine.
